summary.text: Terry Landry is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 67 (East Baton Rouge Parish), and was elected in 2025, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Terry Landry's occupation as Attorney.
It lists education as Bachelor's, Louisiana State University; Juris Doctor, Southern University Law Center; Master of Science, Public Administration, Southern University.

The page lists committee assignments including Commerce, Education and Retirement, and caucus affiliations including the Capital Region Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus and the Democratic Caucus (as whip).
